headline: Shankara Building Products Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - Shankara Building Products Limited has submitted to  the Exchange a copy of Recommendation on the open offer to the shareholders of the company by Committee of Independent Directors in terms of Regulation 26(7) of SEBI (SAST)…
detail: Updates - Shankara Building Products Limited has submitted to  the Exchange a copy of Recommendation on the open offer to the shareholders of the company by Committee of Independent Directors in terms of Regulation 26(7) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011 (SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011)
